subject: Next steps: VP/CTO intro & technical deep-dive scheduling
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgewave.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: VP/CTO intro & technical deep-dive scheduling

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap from our side: EdgeWave is prioritizing
- sustained 99th percentile latency under 250ms for standard requests at 50 QPS
- strict data separation for pilot (EU data residency on dedicated capacity)
- measurable pilot success criteria (throughput target + 95% pass rate on accuracy test set)

To keep momentum, the recommended next step is a short VP/CTO alignment call (to unblock approvals) followed by a deeper technical run-through with your infra team. Two options we can lock now for Claire:

Option A: Thu, Sep 9 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
Option B: Fri, Sep 10 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

If Option B works, we can then schedule a 90-minute technical deep dive the following week (sample slots: Tue/Wed morning).

Attached is a 1-page discovery recap and a short checklist we use to prepare the pilot deep dive. Can you confirm Claire’s availability and whether procurement or security should join the VP/CTO call? Also, any specific agenda items Claire wants covered?

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf (summary), pre-demo-checklist.docx (prep items)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@edgewave.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Nguyen <claire.nguyen@edgewave.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 17:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: VP/CTO intro & technical deep-dive scheduling

Markus —

Appreciate the clear recap. Claire’s calendar is tight this week; she can do Option B (Fri, Sep 10, 2:00–3:00 PM PT). I’ll block that now. Procurement requested a heads-up and may attend the call; I’ve cc’d procurement.

For the technical deep dive, our infra leads prefer Tue/Wed the following week (Sep 14–15) in the morning PT. Can your SE team do Sep 14 AM?
A couple of items Claire wants covered on the VP/CTO call:
- high-level SLA & outage remediation (what does Redwood Guarantee look like for Dedicated?)
- baseline pricing for pilot + cost for dedicated capacity with EU residency
- data flows and isolation model (very high level)

I attached a short security brief so you can route any pre-reads to your solutions team.
Attachment: edgewave-security-brief.pdf
Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of ML Platforms | EdgeWave
samir.patel@edgewave.com | +1 (415) 555-9876

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Fri Sep 10 2:00–3:00 PM PT — VP/CTO intro + proposed agenda

Claire / Samir —

Thanks — confirmed for Fri, Sep 10, 2:00–3:00 PM PT. I sent a calendar invite (placeholder link below) with a suggested agenda:

1) 2–2:10pm PT — Quick intros & success criteria for pilot (Samir, Claire)
2) 2:10–2:25pm PT — Redwood platform overview & EU/dedicated options (Markus / Lauren)
3) 2:25–2:40pm PT — SLA outline, support model, and escalation path (Lauren)
4) 2:40–2:55pm PT — Clarifying questions from Claire + next steps
We’ll keep the conversation high level; technical deep dive to follow with Priyom and your infra leads (we’re targeting Sep 14 AM for that). Priyom, can you confirm availability for Sep 14 AM and whether you prefer an internal runbook or a live demo with synthetic load?
Meeting link / invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/placeholder-12345
Attachments included in prep packet: pre-demo-checklist.docx; I’ve also uploaded the discovery recap to the HubSpot deal record. If you’d like us to share SOC 2 / architecture slides ahead of the VP/CTO call, we can — let me know what level of detail Claire wants.
— Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Hi Claire / Samir —

Quick note from the solutions side — thanks for locking the time. Priyom (cc’d) will host the technical deep dive; he’s able to do Sep 14 AM and prefers a live demo with a short infrastructure Q&A.
I’ve put together a short runbook we’ll use for the deep dive and can attach it to the invite. Also adding a provisional Zoom link and an NDA/Procurement DocuSign in case procurement wants it pre-signed:

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/placeholder-2222
DocuSign NDA: https://docusign.net/edgewave-nda-req
If procurement would like to pre-scan the SOC2 artifacts, we can surface them to the portal before the VP/CTO call.
Thanks — Lauren
